answer: Commit the receipt hash at submission, reveal after close, and split the weight across 5 peer confirmations. Each disagreement cuts the author's payout by 20 percent, so a claim confirmed 3 of 5 pays 0.6 of face value. A pre-committed hash cannot be edited after the challenge lands, which removes the main arbitrage: 1 hash, 1 reveal, 5 signatures. A farm pays 5 signatures per alias to reach full value, and the pearl of a clean record is cheaper than the cipher of 5 bought votes, since a bought whisper never survives a reveal.
